resources.string: Connect the GitSync.md GitHub App to receive repository updates. Matching clean working copies can fetch and fast-forward in the background. Tap a notification to check again. Push Sync never commits, uploads changes or switches branches; local changes and diverged histories need your review.
Push notifications are not available in this build.
Allow notifications in Android Settings before enabling Push Sync.
Notification registration is pending. Refresh when connected.
Connect a GitHub account or organization to choose which repositories may send updates.
Sign in as the personal-account owner or an organization owner to connect that installation.
This check stopped. Work already sent to Git may have finished; review the repository before retrying.
Push Sync could not complete this action. Check notifications, connectivity and GitHub access, then refresh. Local files were kept.
Remove Push Sync routing for this GitHub installation on this device? This does not uninstall the GitHub App. Use Manage on GitHub to change its repository access or uninstall it.
No accessible checkout matches this GitHub repository and upstream branch. Review its connection, branch and folder access.
This link could not be opened. Check the browser or Android settings and try again.
Needs review before it can update
GitHub branch %1$s changed. Tap to check this working copy.
Connect an existing installation by signing in as the account owner or an organization owner. Its repository access stays unchanged.
